status: RECORDED - operational label correction made before any score was computed; author acknowledgement requested

discovery_path.what_happened: The first Track C regeneration on the activated v3.5.0 rerun inputs (worktree scientific-reports-rerun-update, commit e684a3e) froze the truth-free predictions, built the development truth table, and then stopped in the deterministic truth join with 'predictions missing 271 truth loci'.
discovery_path.truth_derived_information_seen: Only locus keys and their counts: the join reported 271 truth loci missing from the predictions; a key-only comparison showed every prediction row labelled cohort '1000G-development-rerun-v3.5.0' and every truth row labelled '1000G-development'. No allele, call correctness, endpoint, interval, ranking or other score was computed or inspected.
discovery_path.cause: scripts/collect_development_rerun.py labels its rows with the rerun's provenance cohort; the truth builder (prepare_development_truth), the result registry and the claim audit key the development cohort by its canonical label. The two key sets therefore could not intersect.

decision.correction: activate_development_rerun.py writes the active primary and abstain caller tables with cohort '1000G-development'. The archived truth-free collection keeps '1000G-development-rerun-v3.5.0', and both input manifests record the two labels under cohort_labels. No other field of any row changes.
decision.history: The earlier activation (8da799d) was reverted (0ecbcc7) and the inputs re-activated with the corrected script, so the record shows both.
decision.unchanged: Roster, release, collector output, caller calls, singleton policy, outer folds, frozen policy, endpoint, consensus rule, panels, multiplicity and every analysis choice. The regeneration runs once more on the relabelled inputs; nothing is tuned against a truth-derived quantity.

authorization.mechanism: Reported to the author in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-25
